topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic opens the lecture with introductory remarks on the nature and complexity of the complement system.

topics.label: Core principles and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational conceptual framework and molecular operating principles of the complement cascade before detailing its individual pathways.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the recognition pathways that converge to trigger C3 deposition on target surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream effector mechanisms by which activated complement eliminates targeted pathogens.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated attack.

topics.label: Clinical complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the distinct clinical presentations and disease susceptibilities associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the mechanisms evolved by pathogens to evade complement-mediated destruction, using Staphylococcus aureus as a primary example.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks and a preview of the upcoming session on adaptive immunity.
